label: CER eCTD 4.0 — Benefit-Risk & PMCF
description: Benefit-risk determination and PMCF plan for VenaGuard™ IVC Filter CER.

inputs.device_name: VenaGuard™ Retrievable Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) Filter
inputs.benefit_1_probability: High (97.9% of patients free from PE at 6 months)
inputs.benefit_1_magnitude: Major — PE prevention is life-saving in high-risk DVT patients
inputs.benefit_1_evidence: 47 publications, 3,412 patients; consistent across study designs
inputs.benefit_2_magnitude: Moderate — eliminates long-term implant risks when filter no longer needed
inputs.benefit_2_evidence: 1,244 retrieval attempts documented across 22 studies; superior to predicate
inputs.benefit_3_name: Low-profile delivery — reduced access site complications
inputs.benefit_3_magnitude: Minor-to-moderate — smaller access site, reduced bleeding, outpatient-compatible
inputs.benefit_3_evidence: Technical comparison to 8F predicate systems; 3 direct comparison studies
inputs.risk_1_severity: Low — majority asymptomatic (grade 1); grade 3 penetration requiring intervention <0.1%
inputs.risk_1_mitigation: Atraumatic hook design; imaging follow-up protocol; documented in IFU
inputs.risk_1_residual: Acceptable — known class effect; rate comparable to or lower than equivalent devices
inputs.risk_2_severity: Moderate — may require repositioning or additional intervention
inputs.risk_2_mitigation: Strut fixation geometry optimized; sizing guidance in IFU; post-placement imaging verification
inputs.risk_2_residual: Acceptable — low probability; rate below predicate device
inputs.risk_3_severity: Serious — potential for strut migration to heart/lungs
inputs.risk_3_mitigation: Nitinol fatigue-life optimization (validated to 10^8 cycles); fracture rate 7× lower than predicate
inputs.risk_3_residual: Acceptable — very low probability; monitoring via PMCF and vigilance reporting
inputs.risk_4_severity: Moderate — may cause lower extremity edema; treatable with anticoagulation or thrombolysis
inputs.risk_4_mitigation: Open filter geometry to maintain laminar flow; anticoagulation when feasible per clinical judgment
inputs.risk_4_residual: Acceptable — consistent with known clinical use of IVC filters; manageable clinically
inputs.overall_benefit_risk: FAVORABLE. The clinical benefits of VenaGuard™ (PE prevention, high retrievability, low-profile delivery) substantially outweigh the identified residual risks. All residual risks are consistent with the known risk profile of conical IVC filters and are at or below the levels observed with the equivalent device (Bard G2 Express). The benefit-risk balance is acceptable for the intended patient population (DVT patients with contraindications to anticoagulation).
inputs.pmcf_study_title: Prospective, Multicenter, Single-Arm Clinical Investigation of VenaGuard™ Retrievable IVC Filter
inputs.pmcf_study_design: Prospective, multicenter (8 sites in EU), single-arm, open-label
inputs.pmcf_primary_endpoint: Technical success rate of filter placement and retrieval (composite endpoint)
inputs.pmcf_secondary_endpoints: PE recurrence rate at 6 months; filter-related complications at 12 months (migration, fracture, IVC penetration, thrombosis); retrieval success rate; procedure time; patient-reported outcomes (EQ-5D-5L)
inputs.pmcf_follow_up: 12 months post-implant (with optional 24-month extension for permanent implants)
inputs.pmcf_registry: EUDAMED registration pending; ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT06XXXXXX
inputs.pmcf_complaint_surveillance: Continuous monitoring of complaint database and vigilance reports. Quarterly trend analysis. FSCA triggers defined in risk management file.
inputs.pmcf_literature_surveillance: Annual systematic literature search update per CEP protocol. Alerts configured for device-specific publications in PubMed.
inputs.pmcf_psur_schedule: Annual PSUR per EU MDR Article 86. First PSUR due 2027-06-01.
